name: What is the average cost of a new luxury driveway?
description: The cost of a new luxury driveway depends on material, size, complexity, and integrated features. A custom estimate is provided after a site assessment.

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a new luxury driveway?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a luxury driveway varies widely based on several factors, including the chosen material (e.g., natural stone, permeable pavers, custom concrete), the driveway's size and complexity, site preparation needs, and any integrated features like custom lighting or drainage systems. While a basic concrete driveway might start at a certain price per square foot, luxury options with premium materials and bespoke designs will be significantly higher. For a precise estimate, we conduct a detailed site assessment and discuss your specific material preferences and design aspirations.
